tagline: The world's busiest maritime hub — and a cross-border commuter sea waiting to happen.
summary: Singapore pairs a dense inner waterfront (Marina Bay, Sentosa, the Southern Islands) with one of the planet's heaviest short-sea passenger flows: millions of people a year crossing to the Riau Islands. It also has a regulator actively mandating clean harbour craft — making it the ideal first-of-class proving ground in Southeast Asia.

use_cases.title: Cross-border water on-demand
use_cases.body: Singapore ↔ Batam (~12 nm) and ↔ Bintan (~30 nm) are within all-electric range. A foiling tier turns a slow, weather-exposed ferry crossing into a fast, smooth, in-app booking — the marquee cross-border super-app story in SEA.

use_cases.title: Clean harbour-craft renewal
use_cases.body: With the regulator already mandating cleaner harbour craft, a software-defined foiling vessel is the premium edge of fleet renewal — quiet, zero-emission, efficient.

use_cases.title: Marina Bay & Southern Islands network
use_cases.body: A fast inner-harbour network linking Marina Bay, Sentosa and the Southern Islands — smooth and weather-tolerant where displacement ferries are not.

use_cases.title: Resort & marina business shuttle
use_cases.body: Direct premium water links from the CBD to Riau resorts and marinas for the regional-HQ business traveller.

use_cases.title: Yacht-club & private tier
use_cases.body: ONE°15 and the marina cluster anchor a private charter tier and reference accounts.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Tanah Merah is the canonical cross-border hub: Batam (~12 nm) and Bintan (~30 nm) sit well inside all-electric range, and the inner Marina ↔ Sentosa ↔ Southern Islands network runs multi-rotation on a single charge. Singapore's regulatory push for clean harbour craft makes it the strongest first-of-class certification path in SEA.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Extends the network beyond the strait — Bintan to the Anambas, and onward regional luxury island-hopping — without charging-infrastructure dependency.

signature_routes: Marina Bay ↔ Sentosa ↔ Southern Islands (inner network)
transit_planning: For the maritime authority: Navier is the premium, zero-emission edge of the harbour-craft renewal the regulator is already mandating — proving software-defined foiling in the world's busiest port, then scaling to the cross-border corridor that no current operator serves well.

grab.note: The cross-border Singapore ↔ Riau crossing is the beachhead: fast, in-app, premium water on the densest short-sea flow in SEA.

singapore-mpa.note: First-of-class clean harbour craft in the world's busiest port.
